defaultTheme.title: Default color theme
defaultTheme.description: Used when a browser has no personal theme choice.

density.title: Interface density
density.description: Spacing in lists and editor controls.

pageSize.title: Records per page
pageSize.description: Rows in collection lists. Collection UI settings can override this default.

editorFontSize.title: Source editor font size
editorFontSize.description: Text size in JSON, Markdown and HTML source editors, in pixels.

validationDelay.title: Live validation delay (ms)
validationDelay.description: Milliseconds after typing before validation runs.

markdownPreview.title: Open Markdown previews by default
markdownPreview.description: Show the rendered preview when opening a Markdown field.

mediaThumbnails.title: Show image thumbnails in media lists
mediaThumbnails.description: Show small image previews beside files in media collections.

tablePageSize.title: Rows per table page
tablePageSize.description: Rows in an open Contents, Items or other embedded table, including the edit form. A field-specific page size takes precedence.
